title: feat(studio): edit an email template or a translation in the All metadata area, and customize a read-only package's one per locale
body:
Fixes #28569 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**：Studio「All metadata」区里,`email_template` 与 `translation` 不再落到通用条目页,而是打开一个简化表单编辑器:Setup 表单的字段(served schema,缺省用内置 schema)+ 该类型已注册的预览(`EmailTemplatePreview` / `TranslationPreview`,挂载复用,非拷贝)。可写包写自己的草稿;只读基座走 N-17 的 Customize 路径(ensure → 草稿写入 `.custom` 并声明 `overrides: {package, basedOn}` → 头部 Publish 发布 pair → ⋯ 菜单「Restore package original」)。 - **为什么改**：此前改一个已安装包的邮件模板或翻译只能去 Setup,写出的是不属于任何包的行;本卡让它成为 pair 里的声明式覆盖(ADR-0146 D2),且邮件模板按 (name, locale) 逐语言覆盖,翻译整包替换并在首次保存前明说。 - **风险与回滚**：改动只在 ui 的 app-shell(新增 `StudioBundleItemEditor.tsx`,`StudioMetadataArea` 的条目路由多一个分支,`useServedOverride` 多一个可选 `member`)与 studio 命名空间三条字符串;服务端零改动。Setup 页面、跨包 `~all` 腿、`?scope=environment`、`?review=1` 仍走通用条目页。回滚 = revert 本 PR。 - **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioBundleItemEditor.tsx` 的 `doSave`(只读基座分支:ensure 一次、`overrideDraftBody`、`recordRead(..., {ifNoneMatch:'*'})`)和 `restoreOriginal`(先删 pair 草稿再删行,均带 `member`);再看 `metadataArea.ts#areaItemOpensFormEditor`。 - **两分钟验证**：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioBundleItemEditor.customize-28569.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioMetadataArea.routes-28561.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.metadataArea-28561.test.tsx`,应全部通过。 - **需要你做的**：无需决策;正常评审即可。Acceptance notes 里有一条与 Interfaces 柱一致的已知行为(Restore 后头部待发布计数不即时刷新)。 ## What changes - **Routing.** `metadataArea.ts` gains `AREA_FORM_EDITOR_TYPES` (`email_template`, `translation`) and `areaItemOpensFormEditor({packageId, type, search})`: true inside one package, outside `?scope=environment` and `?review=1`. `StudioMetadataArea`'s item route (`AreaItemOpen`) decides once: the form editor, else the pillar, else `MetadataResourceEditPage` as before. The item is keyed by `type/name/member`, so another locale is another editor (the draft-save guard's version pin is keyed by type, name and package, not member). - **The editor (`StudioBundleItemEditor.tsx`, new).** `SchemaForm` over the served schema, else the default schema (as the generic item page resolves it), with `name` and `overrides` hidden, and `locale` too for an email template. Beside it, the type's registered preview. Autosave through `useDraftAutoSave` and the shared `useDraftSaveGuard` (same version pin and conflict dialog as the pillars). Header: type, label, locale chip, override badge, autosave status, Customize, ⋯ (History, Restore package original). - **A read-only base.** Customize (`StudioCustomizeButton`) only unlocks the form. The first saved edit calls the surface's `ensure()` once, saves the draft into the pair with `overrides: {package, basedOn}` (`overrideDraftBody`), and bumps the badge. Restore (`StudioRestoreOriginalDialog`) deletes the pair's draft, then its row, at the item's member, then re-reads the base. A walled caller sees Customize disabled with the reason. - **Per member.** Every read, save, badge read and restore of an email template carries `?member=` from the list row's link (`BUNDLE_MEMBER_PARAM`). `useServedOverride` takes an optional `member` and passes it to `getDraft` / `layered`. A translation has no member; before the first save on a read-only base the editor says the whole bundle is replaced. For an email template it says only this locale is customized. - **Surface.** `StudioDesignSurface` passes its existing `customization`, `publishNonce` and `onDraftSaved` to `StudioMetadataArea`; nothing else in the surface moves. - **Strings.** Three `engine.studio.area.formEditor.*` keys in the studio namespace (`en`, `zh`). That table is `Record` outside the locales packs, so `Clause-②: no` holds as claimed. ## Tests - `StudioBundleItemEditor.customize-28569.test.tsx` (new, 6): writable draft of one member (no door, no declaration, no `_` keys, locale field hidden, preview live); read-only Customize of email template zh-CN (ensure once, pair draft body exact with the declaration, badge, base untouched, pair read at member zh-CN); the other locale (en-US) untouched; Restore deletes the pair's draft and row of zh-CN alone and the base reads back; walled admin sees Customize disabled; translation whole-bundle note then the whole bundle saved into the pair, no member in any read. - `StudioMetadataArea.routes-28561.test.tsx` (+4): writable translation and read-only email template at member zh-CN open the editor; `?review=1` and `~all` open the generic page. - `StudioDesignSurface.metadataArea-28561.test.tsx` (+2): the surface hands the area a read-only base's customization (`base`, `baseLabel`, `basedOn`, `walled`, `pairId`, `ensure`), and null for a writable package, whose saved draft moves the changes count.
Ablations (6, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; each landed on disk, went red, and was restored to HEAD by the tool) | # | Mutation | Result | |---|---|---| | A1 | the editor's layered read drops `member` | editor file: 4 failed, 2 passed | | A2 | the badge read (`useServedOverride`) drops `member` | 3 failed, 3 passed | | A3 | `locale` shown in the email template form | 1 failed (writable case), 5 passed | | A4 | the pair draft saved without the `overrides` declaration | 2 failed (email Customize, translation), 4 passed | | A5 | Restore's draft delete drops `member` | 1 failed (Restore), 5 passed | | A6 | `areaItemOpensFormEditor` always false | routes file: 2 failed, 18 passed |
## Acceptance notes - Restore package original does not refresh the header's pending count at once; it emits the metadata-refresh pulse, exactly as the Interfaces pillar's Restore (#28711) does. - An email template's draft PUT takes no `?member=` (400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, supported: force, mode, package, surface); the member is the body's `locale`. The editor sends the body it read, locale included and hidden from the form, so a save stays on its locale. - Server serving was checked before any code: the layered read and the served-override lookup are per member (`overlayMemberWhere`, `memberOption(member)`), so the card's stop rule ("server serves or gates a per-(name, locale) override wrongly") did not fire on reads. The write gate's shipper lookup is per (type, name); see the report's finding. ## Verification - The three card test files: editor 6/6, routes 20/20, surface metadata-area cases green. - Wider set under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`: every test file naming `StudioCustomizeControls`, `useServedOverride`, `StudioMetadataArea`, `metadataArea`, `StudioBundleItemEditor` or `InterfacesPillar`, plus every test importing the studio namespace (`zh-base-term.i18n-13131`, the count-family census among them): 159 files, 2064 tests passed, at `37edd173` (main's merge after it touches no ui file). - `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/i18n`: exit 0 (at `1f6a135c`; the later commits add one lint comment and main's non-ui files). ESLint on the 10 changed ts/tsx: 0 errors (warnings are the files' existing ones plus `react-hooks` advisories). - `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0. - Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`) at `ca3cc565`: 34 of 34 run, each exit 0 (`check:type-check-debt` under the lock); `--ran` reconciles 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 169 files passed, 2 skipped. - Live, on `objectstack dev --fresh` for `examples/app-showcase` (base `com.example.showcase` 0.1.0, which ships `showcase_task_done_email` in `en-US` only): ensure answered 201 then 200 with `com.example.showcase.custom`; a declared draft of `en-US` in the pair saved 200. The write side of the per-locale gate is the report's finding, not this PR's. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01QsR2jTJcKuqRSJyv696zZ9
